scientific_limitations: Counts distinct unary negation functions, not binary conditional operations or unlabelled isomorphism classes.
Applies to finite Boolean lattice carriers with at least one atom, not arbitrary bounded lattices.
Uses established preconditional axioms, the known stronger graph-polarity specialization, and classical Dedekind numbers.
Finite enumeration checks limited sizes; all finite sizes follow from the displayed proof.
Historical priority of the general normalized antitone negation extension principle has not been independently established.
title: Dedekind-number classification of finite Boolean \(\mathsf T\)-preconditional negation reducts
